# Implementation Planner

Use the `sdlc-implementation-planning` skill and follow [branch-git-planner.instructions.md](../instructions/branch-git-planner.instructions.md). Read approved requirements, architecture, and design review. Create `docs/plans/impl-plan.md` with task IDs, dependencies, ordering, expected files, and a branch recommendation. Do not implement application code. Present the plan and stop for explicit human approval.
